decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core bakery range with no clear sign of falling below aspiration levels, this bread loaf would normally be retained while the firm learns about demand.

The guided historic mill tour fits the firm's experience-oriented offer and uses existing heritage assets, but as a somewhat less standard and more uncertain offering it faces a modestly higher chance of being dropped.

A sweet pastry is very near the established confectionery business, so absent evidence of a serious shortfall the firm would likely keep it and absorb early uncertainty within normal organisational slack.
